consequences: Host/SDK validators still accept string-only, so the shape is specified but not enforced until follow-up implementation; corpus gap PX-0056 closes, implementation reconciliation stays open.
context: PX-0056: package-followup-rfc accepts prerelease=true in a manifest dependency entry, but plugin-platform-rfc defined only the string form "id" = "range"; validators fail closed on table entries.
decision_body: Specify the inline-table form "id" = { version = ">=2.0", prerelease = true } alongside the accepted string form: version carries the closed version-requirement string, prerelease is an optional boolean defaulting to false. Recorded as a marked Open reconciliation item because the key spelling and inline-table choice were not literal in accepted text.
rationale: Mirrors the ADR 0009 inline-table convention already accepted for [services.provided] and [lazy].commands in the same manifest, including the 'version' key, and maps to the resolver PackageDependency prerelease flag.
title: Manifest dependency prerelease TOML shape: inline table { version, prerelease }
